items.title: Show HN: CLI and TUI control for dps150 power supply
items.contentSnippet:
Hey HN,
Powercycling and basic power supply measurments are essential part for embedded devices development debug.
But there are no interface for pwoer control for coding agents. So I created that python package which interacts with portable Fnirsi DPS-150, can toggle output, set voltage and current limits.
Unexpected outcome is that it is MUCH MORE convenient to manage it  in terminal and tmux than clicking on the box itself.
TUI dashboard with charts, numbers and hotkeys is included.

items.title: Show HN: Hedwig, a free and open-source alternative to Instantly and Smartlead
items.contentSnippet:
I created an open source alternative to tools like Instantly or Smartlead, which charge huge amounts of money per lead for basic cold email campaign management.
The emails are sent from your inbox, and you get open rates and analytics for your campaign.
It also comes with an MCP server, so you can manage the whole campaign from Claude or Codex.
